name_reason: Already convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'tick' = per-frame state machine, 'summon_anim' = summon-spell animation (battle subsystem), 'variant_b' is a meaningful family discriminator (variant_a @0x269D3 / variant_c/d/e elsewhere are sibling summon-anim state machines), '6slot' is a real array dimension (the per-slot frame/color/jitter arrays are [6] and the tick loops i in 0..5). No Ghidra address residue (no _26bfd-style hex suffix). Name accurately reflects body: indirect dispatch-table entry #5 of the 10-element summon-spell tick table at 0x523B9 (xref from 0x523CD = base+0x14 = entry 5), driving a 6-slot summon-spell animation.
purpose: Per-tick state machine for the variant-B 6-slot summon-spell animation; dispatch-table entry #5, returns a frame-hold/status code consumed by the caster's animation dispatch loop.
logic_summary: Copies the 10-entry per-color y-offset rodata table (data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_b_10color_y_offset_table @0x524D0) into a local; if the caster is on the enemy team (runtime_char[caster].bTeam==0) shifts every local offset by +0x8F. Then dispatches on state_code: 0 (INIT) seeds 6 slots (frame_counter[i]=-2*i staggered start, color_idx[i]=i, jitter[i]=(rng%2)*6 i.e. 0 or 6), sets color_rotation_counter=6 and clears terminate_flag, returns 1; state 3 returns 0xC; state 6 sets terminate_flag and returns 8; states {2,5,8} (TICK) loop the 6 slots: blit the current frame when 0<=frame<6 using jitter+frame sprite index and origin_y+local_offsets[color] row, fire a 2-bucket frame-0 SFX chime (slot 0 -> fd2_play_sfx_with_handle, slot 3 -> fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank, others silent), increment the slot's frame counter, set done_flag at frame==2, and at frame==7 (when not terminated) advance color_rotation_counter mod 10, copy it into the slot color index, restart the slot (frame=0) and re-roll jitter; returns done_flag. Any other state_code returns 0.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot(int caster_unit_id, int sprite_handle, int origin_y, int row_stride, char state_code)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Index into the runtime character array; used to read [caster].bTeam to decide the enemy-team +0x8F row-offset shift.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches body use as a runtime_char_array index; no address residue.

params.name: sprite_handle
params.semantics: Sprite atlas/handle passed straight through to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite for every slot blit.
params.reason: Accurately names the blit sprite handle argument; no address residue.

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Base Y screen coordinate; each blit row = origin_y + local_offsets[color].
params.reason: Matches its use as the blit row origin; no address residue.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride forwarded to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite.
params.reason: Correct name for the blit stride argument; no address residue.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Animation state-machine selector dispatched in the body (0=init, 3, 6=terminate, 2/5/8=tick, else no-op).
params.reason: Correctly names the state dispatch selector; no address residue. (Ghidra types it char; src declares uint32 -- a type nuance, not a naming issue, out of scope for this stage.)

returns.semantics: Frame-hold / status code for the dispatch loop: INIT->1, state3->0xC, state6->8, TICK(2/5/8)->done_flag (1 when any slot frame counter just reached 2, else 0), any other state->0.
